decisions.summary: Nine musical rows contain 52 source spans; every edition bar is a primary, with no written return copies or inserted bars.
decisions.source_basis: Visual row counts 5,7,7,8,7,1,6,6,5; no ditto-bar signs observed. Recurrent motifs have their own written source spans.
decisions.adopted_edition: Identity map is one-to-one and preserves all 52 approved written bars.

decisions.summary: Both section entrance lead-ins occupy actual musical bars; neither adds an extra pickup identity.
decisions.source_basis: S1M1 and S7M1 each visibly occupy the span before their opening repeat boundary.
decisions.adopted_edition: Opening lead-in bar 1 plays initially and in final D.C.; Coda lead-in bar 36 plays each Coda entry, not on C repeat.

decisions.summary: A endings are destination-dependent, with both omitted when returned A leads to C.
decisions.source_basis: S3M5 and S3M6 are distinct numbered musical endings; S3M6 includes a D.-like annotation. The PDF signs alone do not unambiguously settle the later route.
decisions.adopted_edition: Initial A first ending returns to A; second ending enters B. After B second ending, returned A stops at S3M4 and jumps to S7M1. Final D.C. A uses second ending to enter B.

decisions.summary: B second ending leads to A, so it is skipped on the final B-to-C connection.
decisions.source_basis: S5M7 first-ending musical span closes a repeat; S6M1 is a one-bar second ending followed by navigation signs.
decisions.adopted_edition: Initial B uses both endings; B second ending leads back to A. Final D.C. B goes directly from S5M6 to S7M1.

decisions.summary: Navigation after S6M1 and final second-ending D.C. do not create musical bars.
decisions.source_basis: After S6M1 double bar the staff carries navigation signs and no new musical event span. After S9M5 repeat bar, second bracket contains D.C. lettering only.
decisions.adopted_edition: No silent, duplicated or invented bar is assigned to either direction region; final second ending prints as separate direction text.

decisions.summary: The performed route ends at S9M4, before the final musical casilla.

decisions.adopted_edition: After C repeat take D.C. A to B to C without repeats, A via ending 2, B bypassing both endings, and stop at S9M4. Preserved explicit approval: Yes! this lands!

source_vs_edition_route: The PDF visibly supplies the repeat boundaries, musical first/second endings for A/B, Coda entrance, C first ending and direction-only final D.C. It does not by itself establish the precise adopted destination-dependent return route. The preserved human notes and approved P order establish the A-to-C and B-to-C bypasses, final A-B-C without repeats and S9M4 stop. That route is retained exactly; source ambiguities do not reopen approval.

limitations: S8M5 duration source-versus-editorial basis remains unclear; this does not affect span identity.
Navigation glyphs alone do not uniquely derive the human-approved performed route.
